item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring fine and dry weather to Guangdong tomorrow. It will be slightly cooler in the morning over the region. Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will move across the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days, but its intensity remains uncertain. Under the combined effect of the monsoon and Yinxing, it will be windy with a few showers and there will be swells over the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. Yinxing is expected to move southwestwards early next week. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. Besides, a broad area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
